primary_mechanism: Static threshold boundaries on raw sensor readings (e.g. CHT > 230 C)
required_inputs: Raw sensor streams and manufacturer operational limits
assumptions: Hard redline thresholds exist and define health; operating conditions do not shift allowable limits
operating_condition_decoupling: Poor: cannot distinguish high-power climb from degradation; false alarms on transient maneuvers
sensor_fault_resilience: Poor: a stuck or biased sensor triggers an immediate false redline breach
data_leakage_risk: Low: uses only raw sensors and static bounds
suitability_for_engine_twin_v0.2: Unsuitable: synthetic simulator v0.2 has generic assumptions not certified redlines; misses subtle faults

primary_mechanism: Condition-compensated multi-output surrogate baseline f(u) with standardized residual deadband penalties
required_inputs: Operating condition inputs u (throttle altitude ambient temp/pressure) and 10 raw sensors
assumptions: Healthy engine follows deterministic thermodynamic response to operating conditions; residual deviations reflect degradation
operating_condition_decoupling: Excellent: residuals r = y - y_hat explicitly subtract operating point shifts
sensor_fault_resilience: High: isolated sensor bias/drift detected via analytical redundancy and de-weighted from physical EHI
data_leakage_risk: Zero: surrogate trained strictly on normal training flights using deployment inputs only
interpretability: High: each channel residual directly maps to thermodynamic subsystem deviation
suitability_for_engine_twin_v0.2: Optimal: fully aligns with simulator physics and digital twin condition monitoring architecture

primary_mechanism: Statistical distance in multi-sensor space relative to covariance matrix of healthy flights
required_inputs: All 10 sensor measurements; operating condition clustering
assumptions: Sensor measurements follow multivariate normal distribution; cross-sensor covariance is stable
operating_condition_decoupling: Moderate: requires piecewise covariance modeling across flight phases
sensor_fault_resilience: Moderate: single sensor fault shifts entire covariance distance unless explicitly masked
data_leakage_risk: Zero: covariance estimated strictly on normal training flights
interpretability: Moderate: scalar distance lacks localized physical attribution
suitability_for_engine_twin_v0.2: Fair: useful as an unsupervised reference benchmark but less interpretable than residual twin

primary_mechanism: Direct regression model fit to continuous health target HI(t)
required_inputs: Raw sensors and continuous ground-truth health labels HI_true
assumptions: A continuous ground truth target exists and is observable during deployment
operating_condition_decoupling: Model-dependent: requires complex feature engineering to avoid throttle bias
sensor_fault_resilience: Poor: model easily confounds sensor shifts with physical health changes
data_leakage_risk: FATAL LEAKAGE: dataset has no observable continuous target; regressing on simulator-latent states violates deployment realism
suitability_for_engine_twin_v0.2: Inadmissible: rul_hours is NaN; health_index_synthetic is forbidden; no valid target exists
